title: hairpin table
text: hairpin table. You will need to attach the heavy, metal hairpin legs.  The whole unit is very heavy.  The worst part is that the table is not as the photo shows, one solid piece. Nor is it noted anywhere in the ad that the table is glued together scraps.  The one I received was actually 4 pieces of glued scraps.  Looked awful. And then, it literally snapped in half when being turned over (after install legs). The legs were easy to install with provided hardware, they provided an Allen wrench needed to do the leg install. Too bad the table top was so poorly made.  I would not have purchased this table if I would have known prior to purchase that it glued pieces. Other things I noted, the table is about 1 1/2 inches thick.  The edges are not as "natural" as you would think, they are rounded and awkward in a very unnatural way - meaning machined to attempt a natural edge.  I have included photos of the experience - super disappointing on many fronts - including getting a refund. I rarely have to write negative reviews, however, the truth must be shared on this one.  I cannot recommend this table to anyone.
